concerns.text: Task T020 is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on T007 completion ('Sequential - depends on T007 completion, NOT parallel-safe'). The [P] tag is incorrect and creates a false parallelization opportunity that will cause race conditions if T007 and T020 run concurrently.

Task T018 depends on T007 ('completion of T007 - file creation'), yet T018 is not marked [S] (Sequential) nor does it explicitly list T007 as a prerequisite in the dependency section. This hidden dependency violates the 'Producer before consumer' rule and risks T018 running before the imputed data file exists.

Tasks T025 and T032 both implement permutation tests with 10,000 shuffles. While logically independent, the 'Global Execution Constraint' section notes they must be serialized to avoid CI timeout. However, neither task is marked [S] or linked to a semaphore task, and they are placed in parallel phases (US2/US3). Without explicit serialization logic or a [S] tag, the plan implies parallel execution which violates the runtime constraint.

Task T014 calls download functions from T005. While T005 is in Phase 2 and T014 in Phase 3, the dependency is implicit. Explicitly noting 'Depends on T005' in the task description or dependency section would clarify the artifact flow for the 'download.py' module.
